items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: I hired Eddie Condon, Mezz Crow, Cliff Jackson, Frankie Newton and Dave Tough at seven dollars apiece, on Collins Stage

ctx.x: Why did they go to New York? Was that where the --
Condon went first. But one of them went first, and when he got there, waved his hand to those who were behind. Come quick, you're missing out on a fortune. And this kind of thing.

So they -- the next one was -- and I think it may have been that the Chicagoans went at once. I don't know the history of that. But suddenly, I was lonesome. Suddenly, I was alone. I was with the second line, so to speak. The front guys had left. But to me, I hadn't got enough. I was at the ______ every night. It didn't bother me. I was still able to play with Benny Morland, Earl Murphy -- I can't think of his . Wylie who had the -- he had the band at the Liberty. He was a great dancer. He came up with the . And…
